scope: Bounded current Linux x64 core process supervision only; full R8 remains incomplete
status: Measured supervision overhead for one identical disposable workload; no speedup claimed

tests.command: YOLO_BENCH_ARTIFACT=<current artifact> YOLO_BENCH_SDK=<verified extracted pinned SDK> bun test ./packages/core/src/sys/supervisor-benchmark.test.ts

gates.command: Strict scoped tsc --types bun supervisor-benchmark.ts supervisor-benchmark.test.ts

privacy: Disposable fixtures only; no protected stores, service workloads, engine builds or cache cleanup
transport: Native Aphrody MCP nu_eval and primary /home/aphro/yolo/bin/yolo bench CLI

protocol.pairOrder: Alternating direct/native and native/direct; sequential execution
protocol.cold: Fresh Bun driver and SDK/native context for each operation; OS page cache retained
protocol.coldDriverMs: Entire fresh driver process through stdout/stderr collection and exit, including native context unload
protocol.warm: One driver with one shared native context; three unmeasured pairs before samples; child collect/release included; final shared-context unload excluded
protocol.stdio: Both paths ignore stdin and losslessly capture identical stdout/stderr
protocol.memory: Cold RSS/maximum RSS describe each fresh driver; warm RSS includes both modes and the shared native context, so it cannot establish separate memory gains
protocol.limit: 10..100 samples; disposable fixtures; no engine build, cache cleanup, protected data or service workload

limits: One current Linux x64 core artifact and one deterministic short-lived process workload only
Cold means process/context cold, not OS page-cache cold
No desktop, browser, JSC parity, build-time, bundled-size or cross-platform gains are established
The comparison measures direct Bun.spawn against native supervision with stronger process-group/capture lifecycle ownership
Raw paired data is authoritative; no general speedup is inferred

conclusion: For this recorded deterministic workload, native supervision was slower than direct Bun.spawn: cold p50 26.601077 versus 11.390753 ms; warm p50 20.837391 versus 10.937817 ms. No performance gain or full R8 closure is claimed.
